title: Endpoint Device Health Payload (AG-033) v1
description: Wire contract for the AG-033 device-health probe block carried under the COLLECT_INVENTORY result at details.inventory.deviceHealth. Source of truth = platform-agent internal/inventory/device_health.go DeviceHealthResult (PR #36, schemaVersion=1). Backend ingest (device-health persist) and web view (health tab) MUST conform to this shape. Redaction boundary (machine-enforced here, agent-enforced at source): driveLetter only — NO volume label / serial / filesystem / mount path / GUID; lastBootEpochSec is unix seconds, never a local-time string (no tz/locale leak); probeError.summary is bounded operator text (<=200 chars, control-char normalized, static phrasing), never a raw errno or filesystem path. Thresholds (LowDisk, HighPressure, LongUptime) are agent-side const and are NOT carried on the wire / NOT payload-configurable.

schemaVersion.description: Payload schema version. const 1 pins AG-033 v1. A new shape requires a new version + a new schema $id (see forward-compat rule in docs/faz-22-device-health-contract-v1.md).

supported.description: false on non-Windows runtimes (the agent still emits canonical OS metadata so the backend persists 'probe not supported here' instead of treating absence as a failed ingest).

probeComplete.description: false when any probeError is present (fail-closed: degenerate disk/memory/uptime values become a typed probeError + probeComplete=false, never emitted as zeros-as-healthy).

fixedDisks.description: Post-truncation fixed (DRIVE_FIXED) volume entries. ALWAYS serializes as [] (never null). Capped at maxFixedDisks (64).

anyLowDisk.description: OR'd over the FULL pre-truncation disk enumeration (not just the post-truncation fixedDisks array).

sourceUsed.description: win32 = direct Win32 syscalls (GetLogicalDrives/GetDriveType/GetDiskFreeSpaceEx, GlobalMemoryStatusEx, GetTickCount64). none = no probe ran (unsupported).

probeErrors.description: Optional (omitempty at source). Any entry flips probeComplete=false.

driveLetter.description: Uppercase drive letter only. NO label / serial / filesystem / mount path / GUID.

freeBytes.description: freeBytesAvailableToCaller (LocalSystem-writable) — the correct denominator for a 'can this install succeed?' gate, not raw physical free.

commitLimitBytes.description: Approximation from MEMORYSTATUSEX page-file fields, NOT exact per-pagefile/per-process accounting.

lastBootEpochSec.description: Unix seconds, NOT a local-time string (no tz/locale leak).

summary.description: Bounded operator-facing text; static phrasing, control-char normalized; NEVER a raw errno dump or filesystem path.

probeErrors.summary: device-health probe not supported on this runtime
